title: Kill Gui
features:
Main Features
Unlimited Kills – No kill limit on any team, kill everyone
Dynamic Orbit Kill – Orbits selected player at 2.5m-5m radius and 6m-8m height (gets close and far)
Safe Mode – High altitude orbit prevents self-damage from guns while keeping punch in range
Custom Orbit Speed – Type speed (0.01-0.50) in TextBox (default 0.12)
Smart Team Check – Shows only enemy team players (Guards sees Inmates/Criminals, Inmates sees Guards)
Real-time Player List – Displays DisplayName (@username), distance, HP, team
Safety & UX
Warning Popup – Appears on execute (kick risk warning + advice)
Remove / Run Buttons – Remove deletes script completely, Run opens main GUI
Draggable GUI – Professional dark design with Gotham font
Clean Interface – No kills counter
Technical
Normal Melee Damage – Uses meleeEvent:FireServer(player) directly, 100% server-accepted
Smooth Orbit – Real circular path using math.cos/math.sin
Auto Player List Update – Refreshes every 0.8 seconds, auto-adjusts on team change
How to Use (Quick Guide)
Execute script → Click Run on warning
Select enemy player from list
Type desired speed in TextBox and press Enter (example: 0.20)
Click AUTO ON → Dynamic orbit starts and kills target
Click STOP to end
The most reliable and safe Prison Life killer script by TubersBack67!
